name: get_closure
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,subprocess,sys
p=json.loads("{\"url\":\"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2003.09144\",\"routes\":[\"345907\"],\"destination\":\"sources/closure.pdf\",\"source_identity\":\"Dhruv Bhasin Closures of Union Closed Families\",\"purpose\":\"Read closure conjecture equivalence and distinguish conflicting solved metadata\"}")
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','plan-closure.json'],input=json.dumps(p),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','source_get_guard.py','plan-closure.json'],capture_output=True,text=True); print(r.stdout,r.stderr); sys.exit(r.returncode)
